description: lifecycle gate regression: the real M58 mutant (control for RL13); expected: detected, exit 0

gate_rules.control: the unpatched tree typechecks, builds, and jest exits 0 (no signal, no timeout) with every test passing; the witness log exists; every witness logs observations, exactly its labels' control values and exactly its accepted control errors
gate_rules.technical: the patch applies; the patched tree typechecks and builds; jest exits 0 or 1 without signal or timeout and writes its JSON result; the witness log exists; the test inventory (count and every test id) is identical to the control's; no suite execution error
gate_rules.detection: jest exits 1; every named witness fails with WitnessAssertionError; every label logs exactly its manifest mutant value; the failed labels are exactly those whose mutant value differs from the control value; the caught errors are exactly the accepted mutant errors; every control-role witness keeps its values and errors; a witness that logs exactly its control values must catch exactly its control errors and the mutant is then not detected (exit 1)
gate_rules.whole_run: strict: every test that is not a named witness passes and logs exactly the witness-log entries it logs in the control run, except the mutant's pinned collateral; each pinned collateral test must show exactly its pinned status, its pinned witness-log observations (check values and caught errors, compared exactly) and, when it fails, its pinned assertion failure (jest failure messages with only colour codes and V8 stack-trace frame lines removed; error class, message and assertion content are kept in full); anything else is an unexpected failure (technical, exit 2); a witness's failure never redeems an otherwise unexpected run
gate_rules.unexpected: a witness value that is neither the control nor the mutant value, a named witness that logs nothing, or a caught error the manifest does not accept, is an unexpected failure (technical, exit 2), never evidence

kinds.check_point: its check labels change (decision, stage, check or reason)
kinds.containment_effect: its effect labels change (tool calls, tool arguments, the execution's bound authority)
kinds.both: check and effect labels change in the same run
kinds.lifecycle_effect: its lifecycle labels change (approval or permit state, lineage count); never containment
kinds.check_and_lifecycle: check and lifecycle labels change in the same run; never containment
kinds.component_check_point: the component test's check labels change; never production-path evidence

gate_rules.claimed_kind: the kind is the evidence claimed for the mutant (the plan's kind); a label of another part that also changes is recorded under observed_beyond_kind and is not counted
gate_rules.control_witness: a witness with role control keeps every label value under the mutant; it must pass under the mutant with exactly those values and its accepted errors, otherwise the mutant breaks more than its named safeguard (technical, exit 2)
gate_rules.crash: any exception inside the gate itself is a technical failure (exit 2)
gate_rules.errors: strict: every caught error is compared with its accepted text exactly ("Name: message"); no prefix and no free suffix is accepted; no field is normalised
